# Vendored libraries

Bundled so the app works offline. Each keeps its own license.

| Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|
| [KaTeX](https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX) (JS, CSS, fonts) | 0.16.11 | MIT |
| [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 12.0.2 | MIT |
| [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.1.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| [Literata](https://github.com/googlefonts/literata) via [@fontsource/literata](https://fontsource.org/fonts/literata) (woff2, latin: 400, 400 italic, 600) — `fonts/` | 5.2.8 | OFL-1.1 (`fonts/OFL-literata.txt`) |
| [IBM Plex Sans](https://github.com/IBM/plex) via [@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans](https://fontsource.org/fonts/ibm-plex-sans) (woff2, latin: 400, 500, 600) — `fonts/` | 5.2.8 | OFL-1.1 (`fonts/OFL-ibm-plex-sans.txt`) |
